chests.locked: A CHEST IN THE CHAPEL'S CRYPT, BLACK AS PITCH. WE CAN'T EVEN FIND THE LATCH WITHOUT A LIGHT.
A GNOMISH STRONGBOX, DEEP IN A LIGHTLESS WORKSHOP. SOMETHING TICKS INSIDE. WE NEED A LIGHT TO SEE THE DIALS.
A CRACK IN THE CHAPEL FLOOR. BELOW IT, A FLOODED CISTERN, FULL TO THE BRIM - AND SOMETHING GLINTS AT THE BOTTOM. WE'D HAVE TO SWIM DOWN FOR IT.
chests.dive: DEEP BREATH... DOWN WE GO. GOT IT - SOMETHING WRAPPED IN OILCLOTH!

boss.name: SHADOW OF THE GATEWARDEN
boss.sub: A CURSED ECHO, ROOTED TO THE WARD STONE ABOVE
fall: THE CURSED VINE WITHERS... SOMETHING STIRS BENEATH THE WARD STONE.

lines: NORTH: BRIGHTWATER. (WHAT REMAINS OF IT.)
EAST: THE WARD STONE. TURN BACK. NO, REALLY.
SOUTH: MISTFEN. BRING BOOTS.
NORTH: BRIGHTWATER. (WHAT REMAINS OF IT.)
EAST: THE BROKEN WARD STONE. (SOMEONE HAS SCRATCHED OUT 'TURN BACK'.)
SOUTH: MISTFEN. BRING BOOTS.
MISTFEN AHEAD.
THE CAVE IN THE FEN IS SAID TO HOLD A HOOK THAT REACHES WHERE NO LADDER DOES.
EAST: THE OLD WATCHTOWER.
WEST: THE VALE. AND A VERY CROSS FROG.
EAST: THE OLD WATCHTOWER.
WEST: THE VALE. AND A VERY RELIEVED KING.
GLOAMWOOD. KEEP TO THE ROADS.
IF A LIGHT IN THE TREES CALLS YOUR NAME, IT ISN'T A FRIEND. PROBABLY.
EAST: CINDERREACH. THE GROUND GETS WARM. THEN HOT. THEN WORSE.
WEST: GLOAMWOOD. THE GROUND GETS DARK. THEN DARKER.
THE HERMIT IS NOT IN.
THE HERMIT IS NEVER IN. THE HERMIT CAN SEE YOU READING THIS. - THE HERMIT
SOUTH: CINDERREACH. ASH ROADS, HOT WINDS, WORSE MANNERS.
EMBERWATCH. EMBER SALVE SOLD HERE.
OUT IN THE ASH THE HEAT WILL COOK YOU SLOWLY. BUY SALVE. TRUST US.
ST. CINDER'S. UP THE STEPS. MIND THE MONKS, THEY BLESS YOU WHETHER YOU LIKE IT OR NOT.
THE CHAPEL OF THE UNDIMMED.
WHOEVER TENDS THE FLAME, TENDS US ALL.
(BELOW, A HYMN IS CARVED:) 'SING LOW TO WAKE THE MORNING, THEN HIGHEST FOR THE LIGHT; THEN DEEPEST FOR THE SLEEPERS, AND MIDDLE FOR THE NIGHT.'
TINKERWORKS. KNOCK TWICE.
(THE DOOR HAS BEEN KNOCKED DOWN.)
OLD SEAM NO. 4 - CLOSED.
TOO HOT EVEN FOR DWARVES. THAT'S SAYING SOMETHING.
THE OLD BELFRY.
IT USED TO RING THE HOURS FOR THE WHOLE WOOD. NOW THE WOOD KEEPS ITS OWN HOURS.
THE OLD BELFRY.
IT RINGS THE HOURS FOR THE WHOLE WOOD AGAIN. MOSTLY THE RIGHT ONES.
HERE LIES THE KING'S CHAMPION.
HE STOOD AT THE GATE SO OTHERS COULD RUN. THE DOOR IS IRON SO NO ONE CAN TAKE HIS HELM. (SOMEONE STRONG COULD.)
OLD FENMILL.
DROWNED IN THE BIG FLOOD. THE MILLER SWAM. THE MILL DIDN'T.
THE OLD ROAD TO FROSTHELM. UP THE STAIRS.
WRAP UP. NO, WARMER THAN THAT.
RIMEWATCH. FROST TONIC SOLD HERE.
OUT IN THE SNOW THE COLD WILL TAKE YOU BIT BY BIT. STAY NEAR A FIRE OR DRINK SOMETHING HOT.
GLASSWATER. THE ICE HOLDS. MOSTLY.
THE WIND ON THE OPEN ICE IS THE COLDEST THING IN THE HIGHLANDS. AFTER THE WARDEN'S STARE.
THE BLIGHT BASIN. THE CAUSEWAY RUNS TO THE NINTH TOWER.
THE BARRIER WALLS OFF EVERYTHING ELSE. EVERY WARD STONE YOU BREAK TAKES A LAYER AWAY. TURN BACK. PLEASE.
THE BLIGHT BASIN. THE CAUSEWAY RUNS TO WHAT'S LEFT OF THE NINTH TOWER.
THE BARRIER IS GONE, AND SO IS HE. (SOMEONE HAS SCRAWLED UNDERNEATH: 'TURN BACK? NEVER!')
BRIGHTWATER MILL.
(THE WHEEL HASN'T TURNED IN A YEAR. SOMEONE HAS CHALKED 'BROKE' ON THE DOOR.)
BRIGHTWATER MILL.
FLOUR, BREAD AND GOOD MOODS, ALL RESTORED. (THE CHALK NOW SAYS 'FIXED BY GIZMO'.)

npcs.name: MARLA
lines: WELCOME TO MARLA'S! THE CURSE TURNED ME INTO A NEWT FOR A WEEK. BAD FOR BUSINESS.
TAKE A LOOK. I BUY, I SELL, I DO NOT DO REFUNDS.

npcs.name: BRUNO
lines: FANCY A ROUND OF HEXLING WHACK? TEN GOLD A GAME.
WHACK THE HEXLINGS, NOT THE CURSE WISPS. BIG SCORES WIN BIG PRIZES. I HEAR A GOLDEN FLY IS IN THE PRIZE BOX...

wards.lifts: THE CURSE LIFTS FROM THE VALE

murk.name: SHADOW OF MOTHER MURK
murk.sub: A CURSED ECHO, ROOTED TO THE WARD STONE ABOVE
fall: THE CURSED VINE WITHERS... SOMETHING STIRS IN THE BOG BY THE WARD STONE.

wardBosses.name: THE GATEWARDEN
wardBosses.sub: GUARDIAN OF THE VALE WARD STONE
fall: NOTHING GUARDS THE WARD STONE NOW. BREAK IT!

wardBosses.name: MOTHER MURK
wardBosses.sub: GUARDIAN OF THE MISTFEN WARD STONE
fall: NOTHING GUARDS THE WARD STONE NOW. BREAK IT!

wardBosses.name: THE PALE HUNTSMAN
fall: THE HUNT IS ENDED. NOTHING GUARDS THE STONE NOW. BREAK IT!

wardBosses.name: FORGEMASTER VULK
wardBosses.sub: KEEPER OF THE FORGE THAT NEVER COOLS
fall: THE FORGE COOLS. NOTHING GUARDS THE STONE NOW. BREAK IT!

wardBosses.name: ISOLDE THE RIMEGUARD
wardBosses.sub: MALGRIM'S KNIGHT OF THE ENDLESS WINTER
fall: SHE KNEELS IN THE SNOW... AND IS GONE. NOTHING GUARDS THE STONE NOW. BREAK IT!

townsfolk.name: PERCY THE MILLER
townsfolk.quirk: THE HEX MADE ME HICCUP BUBBLES. *HIC* ...BLOOP. IT'S HUMILIATING.
townsfolk.home: NO MORE BUBBLES. MOSTLY. *BLOOP*. THAT ONE WAS ON PURPOSE.

townsfolk.name: NELL
townsfolk.quirk: !EM PLEH. ...SORRY. I'VE BEEN SPEAKING BACKWARDS FOR A MONTH. IT'S THE HEX.
townsfolk.home: I CAN SAY 'THANK YOU' THE RIGHT WAY ROUND. THANK YOU!

townsfolk.name: OLD BRAMBLE
townsfolk.quirk: MY BEARD WON'T STOP GROWING. IT'S PAST MY KNEES AND IT HAS OPINIONS.
townsfolk.home: I KEPT A LITTLE OF THE BEARD. FOR LUCK.

townsfolk.name: SER TOBY
townsfolk.quirk: I CAN ONLY WALK IN SQUARES. LEFT, UP, RIGHT, DOWN. I'VE BEEN CIRCLING THIS ROCK FOR DAYS.
townsfolk.home: I WALKED HERE IN A STRAIGHT LINE. GLORIOUS.

townsfolk.name: MARIGOLD
townsfolk.quirk: EVERYTHING I TOUCH TURNS TO PORRIDGE. I WAS A LOCKSMITH.
townsfolk.home: I MADE A KEY TODAY. A REAL ONE. I CRIED.

townsfolk.name: OLD WADE
townsfolk.quirk: I'M QUITE SURE I'M A HERON NOW. I'VE EATEN FOUR FISH TODAY. RAW.
townsfolk.home: I'VE GONE BACK TO COOKED FISH. MOSTLY.

townsfolk.name: HETTY
townsfolk.quirk: MY SHADOW LEFT ME. IT'S OVER THERE BEHIND THE REEDS, SULKING.
townsfolk.home: MY SHADOW CAME BACK. WE'RE TALKING AGAIN.

townsfolk.name: GRUFF THE COOPER
townsfolk.quirk: I FLOAT A LITTLE WHEN I'M HAPPY. I HAVEN'T FLOATED IN WEEKS.
townsfolk.home: LOOK! I'M FLOATING! ...AN INCH. IT COUNTS.

townsfolk.name: LIDDY
townsfolk.quirk: ~THE HEX TURNED ALL MY WORDS TO SONG~ ~AND I CAN'T EVEN SING~
townsfolk.home: I CAN TALK AGAIN! ...I KIND OF MISS THE SINGING.

townsfolk.name: BARTHOLOMEW
townsfolk.quirk: I SNEEZE SPARKS. I'VE SET FIRE TO THREE HATS AND A GOAT. THE GOAT WAS FINE.
townsfolk.home: NOT ONE SPARK ALL WEEK. THE GOAT SENDS ITS REGARDS.

townsfolk.name: TIMMONS THE TINKER
townsfolk.quirk: EVERYTHING I TOUCH TURNS TO MOSS. THIS WAS A SPOON. NOW IT'S A MOSS SPOON.
townsfolk.home: I'M MENDING POTS IN BRIGHTWATER NOW. NOT ONE OF THEM HAS SPROUTED.

townsfolk.name: GRANNY WEFT
townsfolk.quirk: MY SHADOW WANDERS OFF AT NIGHT. LAST WEEK IT CAME HOME WEARING SOMEONE ELSE'S HAT.
townsfolk.home: MY SHADOW STAYS PUT NOW. I KEPT THE HAT.

townsfolk.name: PIPKIN THE PEDLAR
townsfolk.quirk: I CAN ONLY SPEAK IN RHYME. IT'S A CRIME. ALL THE TIME. ...SEE?
townsfolk.home: PROSE! BLESSED PROSE! I'VE BEEN TALKING FOR SIX HOURS STRAIGHT.

townsfolk.name: SISTER MAYWEED
townsfolk.quirk: I GLOW IN THE DARK. THE MOTHS ADORE ME. I DO NOT ADORE THE MOTHS.
townsfolk.home: NO MORE GLOWING. THE MOTHS HAVE MOVED ON TO A LAMPPOST. GOOD RIDDANCE.

townsfolk.name: BARNABY BRACKEN
townsfolk.quirk: MY FEET HAVE TAKEN ROOT. NOT A FIGURE OF SPEECH. ACTUAL ROOTS.
townsfolk.home: I CAN WALK AGAIN! I'VE BEEN WALKING IN CIRCLES ALL MORNING, JUST BECAUSE.

townsfolk.name: FLINT THE SMELTER
townsfolk.quirk: EVERYTHING I SAY COMES OUT AS SMOKE SIGNALS. ...THAT PUFF WAS 'HELLO'.
townsfolk.home: I CAN TALK AGAIN! I'VE KEPT A FEW PUFFS FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS.

townsfolk.name: MOTHER ASHBY
townsfolk.quirk: MY HAIR IS ON FIRE. HAS BEEN FOR A WEEK. IT DOESN'T HURT. IT'S JUST VERY HARD TO SLEEP.
townsfolk.home: MY HAIR IS JUST HAIR NOW. A BIT SINGED. VERY FASHIONABLE IN BRIGHTWATER, APPARENTLY.

townsfolk.name: TOBIAS TINDER
townsfolk.quirk: EVERYTHING I COOK TURNS TO CHARCOAL. EVERYTHING. I TRIED TO MAKE A SALAD.
townsfolk.home: I MADE A SALAD THIS MORNING. IT WAS GREEN. I ATE THE WHOLE THING STANDING UP.

townsfolk.name: OLD BELLOWS
townsfolk.quirk: I CAN ONLY WHISPER. WHENEVER I RAISE MY VOICE, SOMETHING CATCHES FIRE.
townsfolk.home: I CAN SHOUT AGAIN. I SHOUTED ALL THE WAY HERE. NOTHING BURNED. GLORIOUS.

townsfolk.name: PRIM CINDERLY
townsfolk.quirk: I'M MADE OF GLASS FROM THE ELBOWS DOWN. PLEASE DON'T TOUCH. PLEASE DON'T BREATHE TOO HARD.
townsfolk.home: FLESH AND BLOOD AGAIN. I'VE BEEN HUGGING EVERYONE. THEY'VE BEEN VERY PATIENT.

townsfolk.name: BRAM THE FISHER
townsfolk.quirk: EVERY TIME I SPEAK, A FISH COMES OUT. ...SORRY. THAT ONE WAS A HERRING.
townsfolk.home: NO FISH! JUST WORDS! I'VE NEVER BEEN SO HAPPY TO BE BORING.

townsfolk.name: OLD MAGDA
townsfolk.quirk: I'M FROZEN TO THIS SPOT. NOT IN A POETIC WAY. MY BOOTS ARE STUCK TO THE GROUND.
townsfolk.home: I WALKED ALL THE WAY TO BRIGHTWATER. MY FEET ARE THRILLED. MY KNEES LESS SO.

townsfolk.name: SVEN THE PEDLAR
townsfolk.quirk: EVERYTHING I TOUCH TURNS TO SNOW. I USED TO SELL SPOONS. NOW I SELL SMALL PILES OF SNOW.
townsfolk.home: I SOLD A SPOON TODAY! IT STAYED A SPOON ALL THE WAY TO THE CUSTOMER'S HOUSE!

townsfolk.name: INGRID
townsfolk.quirk: MY TEETH WON'T STOP CHATTERING. NOT FROM THE COLD - THEY'RE TAPPING OUT MESSAGES. RUDE ONES.
townsfolk.home: MY TEETH ARE QUIET. I STILL DON'T KNOW WHO THEY WERE TALKING TO.

townsfolk.name: BROTHER HOBNAIL
townsfolk.quirk: I SNEEZE SNOWFLAKES. EACH ONE IS UNIQUE. I'VE NAMED SEVERAL HUNDRED.
townsfolk.home: NO MORE SNOWFLAKES. I MISS GERALD. GERALD WAS MY FAVOURITE.

townsfolk.name: SER ANSELM
townsfolk.quirk: I CAN ONLY MARCH FORWARD. I'VE BEEN WALKING INTO THIS ROCK FOR A WEEK. HONOURABLY.
townsfolk.home: I TURNED AROUND TODAY! ALL THE WAY AROUND! I FELL OVER, BUT STILL.

townsfolk.name: HEDDA THE HERBALIST
townsfolk.quirk: EVERY PLANT I TOUCH WILTS. I'M A HERBALIST. YOU SEE THE PROBLEM.
townsfolk.home: I GREW A DAISY. A WHOLE DAISY. I'VE NAMED IT AND I TALK TO IT AND NO, I WON'T STOP.

townsfolk.name: CORWIN
townsfolk.quirk: EVERY DOOR I OPEN LEADS BACK OUTSIDE. I HAVEN'T BEEN INDOORS IN A MONTH. I MISS CEILINGS.
townsfolk.home: I WALKED INTO A HOUSE TODAY AND I WAS IN A HOUSE. I SAT UNDER THE CEILING FOR AN HOUR.

townsfolk.name: WENNA
townsfolk.quirk: WHENEVER I SIT DOWN, I SINK. NOT IN THE BOG. IN CHAIRS. IN ROCKS. ANYWHERE.
townsfolk.home: I SAT ON A STOOL THIS MORNING AND STAYED ON TOP OF IT. MY HUSBAND CLAPPED.

townsfolk.name: FERGUS THE BELLOWS-BOY
townsfolk.quirk: EVERY TIME I BREATHE OUT, IT'S A GUST. I'VE BLOWN OUT EVERY FIRE IN EMBERWATCH. TWICE.
townsfolk.home: I BLEW ON MY SOUP AND IT DIDN'T LEAVE THE BOWL. THIS IS THE LIFE.

huntsman.name: SHADOW OF THE PALE HUNTSMAN
huntsman.sub: A CURSED ECHO, BOUND TO THE ELDER'S HEARTWOOD
fall: THE CURSED VINE WITHERS... HOUNDS HOWL IN THE FOG BY THE WARD STONE.

vulk.name: SHADOW OF FORGEMASTER VULK
vulk.sub: A CURSED ECHO, CHAINED TO THE DWARVES' HEARTHSTONE
fall: THE CURSED VINE BURNS AWAY... THE LAVA VENT BY THE WARD STONE BEGINS TO BOIL.

falseWalls.locked: A WALL OF OLD STONE. IT FEELS... THIN, SOMEHOW. LIKE A PAINTING OF A WALL. IF ONLY WE COULD SEE WHAT'S REALLY THERE.
A RUINED SHRINE'S WALL. THE STONES SHIMMER WHEN YOU AREN'T LOOKING STRAIGHT AT THEM.

isolde.name: SHADOW OF ISOLDE
isolde.sub: A CURSED ECHO, BOUND TO THE ASTRONOMERS' STAR-MIRROR
fall: THE CURSED VINE CRACKS LIKE ICE... FROST GATHERS BY THE WARD STONE.

echoMarsh.name: WARD ECHO: MOTHER MURK
echoMarsh.sub: THE MISTFEN STONE STILL STANDS, AND IT REMEMBERS HER

echoGloam.name: WARD ECHO: THE PALE HUNTSMAN
echoGloam.sub: THE GLOAMWOOD STONE STILL STANDS, AND THE HUNT GOES ON

echoCinder.name: WARD ECHO: FORGEMASTER VULK
echoCinder.sub: THE CINDERREACH STONE STILL STANDS, AND ITS FORGE STILL BURNS

echoFrost.name: WARD ECHO: ISOLDE
echoFrost.sub: THE FROSTHELM STONE STILL STANDS, AND ITS KNIGHT STILL GUARDS IT

malgrim.name: MALGRIM THE UNKIND
malgrim.sub: COURT MAGE TO THE FROG KING. ARCHITECT OF THE NINTH TOWER
